verdict.rationale: Runway Dev exposes its generative models over a first-party HTTP API with an npm SDK, cURL usage, a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec (probe-confirmed), and an async task-polling pattern. Workflows can also be published as versioned endpoints. Together these let users drive the product headlessly from scripts or pipelines without the web UI. Missing for 10: a CI-specific guide or example, a first-party CLI, documentation of non-interactive auth (API keys/env vars) for pipelines, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
